component.name: Support queue status panel
component.recommended_surface: Authored browser HTML preview; for an assistant integration, use a negotiated MCP App View with a meaningful text result fallback.

selected_patterns.trigger: A user selects a request and stages a priority edit.
selected_patterns.input_data_contract: Stable request ID plus one of low, medium, high, or urgent.
selected_patterns.implementation_rule: Keep the draft separate from committed ticket data, validate locally, and keep the draft after a rejected save.
selected_patterns.failure_fallback: Show a labeled validation or save error and retain the previous successful row plus the draft.
selected_patterns.validation: Use the browser controls to select, edit, save, cancel, submit an invalid blank value, and simulate a save failure.

selected_patterns.trigger: Refresh or save takes time and may succeed or fail.
selected_patterns.input_data_contract: Current local snapshot, selected ID, draft priority, and a pending operation.
selected_patterns.implementation_rule: Mark busy state, preserve the last successful view, and apply only the local operation result.
selected_patterns.failure_fallback: Keep the previous snapshot visible and provide a retryable error message.
selected_patterns.validation: Use the refresh and save simulation switches to reach busy, success, and error states.

selected_patterns.input_data_contract: Selected stable ID and human-readable current values.
selected_patterns.implementation_rule: Provide a concise text-only summary in the expandable fallback region.
selected_patterns.failure_fallback: The summary remains understandable without row styling, scripts, or host UI.
selected_patterns.validation: Open Text-only fallback and read the selected request, priority, status, and actions.

selected_patterns.trigger: The preview is resized or viewed in a narrow container.
selected_patterns.input_data_contract: Available width and keyboard focus state.
selected_patterns.implementation_rule: Use responsive wrapping, a horizontal table fallback, visible focus, and authored English labels.
selected_patterns.failure_fallback: The table can scroll horizontally while the controls remain reachable.
selected_patterns.validation: Resize below 650 CSS pixels and tab through every control.

usability_review.label: Visible status
usability_review.interaction: refresh, save, cancellation, empty result, and recovery
usability_review.finding: Busy, complete, failed, cancelled, and empty messages are represented in a live region.
usability_review.fix: Keep the prior successful snapshot visible after refresh failure.
usability_review.evidence: untested — implementation inspection only; no representative-user test

usability_review.label: Familiar concepts
usability_review.finding: Request, priority, status, save, and cancel use task vocabulary.
usability_review.fix: Keep protocol codes out of the primary display.
usability_review.evidence: untested — implementation inspection only; no representative-user test

usability_review.label: Control and exits
usability_review.finding: Cancel is a separate action and explicitly reports discarded changes.
usability_review.fix: Retain Cancel and a retry path in any host adaptation.
usability_review.evidence: untested — implementation inspection only; no representative-user test

usability_review.label: Consistent conventions

usability_review.fix: Preserve native host conventions when translating to a native surface.
usability_review.evidence: untested — implementation inspection only; no representative-user test

usability_review.label: Prevent mistakes
usability_review.finding: Blank priority is rejected and edits are staged before commit.

usability_review.evidence: untested — implementation inspection only; no representative-user test

usability_review.label: Recognition cues
usability_review.finding: ID, title, current priority, status, labels, and selection context are adjacent.

usability_review.evidence: untested — implementation inspection only; no representative-user test

usability_review.label: Efficient paths
